name: review-run-clean-tree-preflight
title: Add a material-source clean-tree preflight to review_run_start
description: Refuse review_run_start when the working tree has uncommitted BLOCKING changes (material-source or fixture), reusing the DONE gate's shared dirty evaluation (classifyGitStatusRows + DIRTY_GATE_POLICY via evaluateDirtyGate). A fail-fast UX gate that prevents reviewers from snapshotting a tree about to drift and lose the round; lattice metadata / runtime artifacts / declared artifacts stay non-blocking. Not a soundness gate (evidence-freshness at write time remains that); cannot catch a commit made after the snapshot. Requires exporting/extracting the currently-private readGitStatusLines without changing DONE-gate behavior.
